entries.title: Psalms 135:1
segments: ¶Hallelujah! Praise the name of Jehovah; praise, ye servants of Jehovah,

entries.title: Psalms 135:2
segments: Ye that stand in the house of Jehovah, in the courts of the house of our God.

entries.title: Psalms 135:3
segments: Praise ye Jah; for Jehovah is good: sing psalms unto his name; for it is pleasant.

entries.title: Psalms 135:4
segments: For Jah hath chosen Jacob unto himself, Israel for his own possession.

entries.title: Psalms 135:5
segments: ¶For *I* know that Jehovah is great, and our Lord is above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 135:6
segments: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, he hath done in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all deeps;

entries.title: Psalms 135:7
segments: Who causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; who maketh lightnings for the rain; who bringeth the wind out of his treasuries:

entries.title: Psalms 135:8
segments: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast;

entries.title: Psalms 135:9
segments: Who sent signs and miracles into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh and upon all his servants;

entries.title: Psalms 135:10
segments: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings,

entries.title: Psalms 135:11
segments: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;

entries.title: Psalms 135:12
segments: And gave their land for an inheritance, an inheritance unto Israel his people.

entries.title: Psalms 135:13
segments: Thy name, O Jehovah, is for ever; thy memorial, O Jehovah, from generation to generation.

entries.title: Psalms 135:14
segments: For Jehovah will judge his people, and will repent in favour of his servants.

entries.title: Psalms 135:15
segments: ¶The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men's hands:

entries.title: Psalms 135:16
segments: They have a mouth, and they speak not; eyes have they, and they see not;

entries.title: Psalms 135:17
segments: They have ears, and they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 135:18
segments: They that make them are like unto them, --every one that confideth in them.

entries.title: Psalms 135:19
segments: House of Israel, bless ye Jehovah; house of Aaron, bless ye Jehovah;

entries.title: Psalms 135:20
segments: House of Levi, bless ye Jehovah; ye that fear Jehovah, bless Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 135:21
segments: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion, who dwelleth at Jerusalem! Hallelujah!
